strings.VaultHint: First use creates a password vault. Keep this password and back up the data directory; it cannot be recovered. Windows DPAPI vaults must be exported by their Windows user first.
strings.SystemVaultHint: New macOS vaults unlock with your login keychain. Existing password vaults keep their original password. Keep an encrypted OpenPGP export for backup.
strings.SystemVaultFailed: Unable to open the login keychain. Unlock your macOS desktop session and allow system authorization, then retry. Check data integrity and close other PGPMint sessions. Existing vault data has not been replaced.
strings.SleepProtected: System sleep is inhibited while searching.
strings.SleepUnavailable: Sleep inhibition is unavailable; the system may sleep. Check system power settings.
strings.NoTray: No recoverable tray is available. Quitting stops search.
strings.ExportRequired: Specify a UID name or email and a nonempty export passphrase.
strings.LocalFileRequired: Choose a local filesystem path for secure export.
strings.TargetRequired: Enter a target Key ID suffix.
strings.BackendError: GPU discovery failed. Check the graphics driver and supported compute runtime.
strings.UnlockFailed: Unable to unlock vault. Check the password, data integrity and whether another PGPMint session is open.
strings.OperationFailed: Operation failed. Check the data directory, available space, and driver diagnostics.
strings.NoTrayHint: Background mode requires a working tray/menu bar. Closing otherwise asks to stop and quit.
